messages:
Leila Farouk: anyone know how to reproduce this Optimize quality gate failure locally? seeing a FAIL in staging for a quant profile change but i can’t get it to fail when i run the suite on my laptop. gate_run_id `gtr_9f2c1d6a` (from Console) / route `search-prod-rerank` / model `rw-open-llama-70b`.

Olivia Grant: yep, this one is tricky — it only fails with the long-context prompt subset + the exact baseline selection we used in the run.

Olivia Grant: can you paste the artifact link from the gate run? should include `baseline_config.json` and `config_diff.json`.

Leila Farouk: from Console -> Gate run -> Artifacts:
- `artifact://quality-gates/gtr_9f2c1d6a/config_diff.json`
- `artifact://quality-gates/gtr_9f2c1d6a/baseline_config.json`
- `artifact://quality-gates/gtr_9f2c1d6a/results.json`

EvalHarness Bot: Artifacts resolved for `gtr_9f2c1d6a` (region: us-east). Suite: `optimize_gating_full_v1`. Prompt sets: `ps_opt_gating_quant_longctx_v1`, `ps_opt_gating_chat_mixed_v2`.

Olivia Grant: perfect. quickest repro is to run eval-harness against the same prompt set id + configs.

Olivia Grant: 1) grab the artifacts locally (if you have `rw` cli):
```bash
rw artifacts pull artifact://quality-gates/gtr_9f2c1d6a/config_diff.json -o /tmp/config_diff.json
rw artifacts pull artifact://quality-gates/gtr_9f2c1d6a/baseline_config.json -o /tmp/baseline_config.json
```

Olivia Grant: 2) run eval-harness in “gating local” mode (needs GPU). from `eval-harness/`:
```bash
# make sure you’re on the same commit range as staging
git checkout main && git pull

# recommended: run just the failing prompt set first
./bin/eval-harness gating run \
  --suite optimize_gating_full_v1 \
  --prompt-set ps_opt_gating_quant_longctx_v1 \
  --baseline /tmp/baseline_config.json \
  --diff /tmp/config_diff.json \
  --output /tmp/gtr_9f2c1d6a_repro \
  --seed 1337 \
  --max-parallel 4
```

Leila Farouk: do i need any special flags for the quant profile baseline? i think my local run is picking a different baseline than what Optimize used.

Arjun Desai: yeah — Optimize baseline selection for quant is per (model_family, gpu_sku, ctx_bucket). if you don’t pass the baseline file, harness will try to infer and you’ll get a “clean” run.

Arjun Desai: using `/tmp/baseline_config.json` should lock it. also make sure your local runner is on an A100 or H100 matching the run.

Grace Kim: ^ this gate run was on `gpu_sku=h100-sxm` (from results.json). if you run on A100 you might not trigger the same kernel path.

Leila Farouk: ah ok, i’m on A100 locally. can i still repro?

Grace Kim: you can reproduce the metric delta sometimes, but not reliably. best path is to run it on a dev H100 box.

Connor O'Brien: if you need an H100 quickly, you can use the shared “ml-dev-h100” pool. request via `#eng-platform` or just run through the CI GPU job.

Connor O'Brien: we have a canned job for this exact use case:
```bash
# from redwood repo
./tools/ci/run_gpu_job.sh \
  --pool ml-dev-h100 \
  --command "cd eval-harness && ./bin/eval-harness gating run --suite optimize_gating_full_v1 --prompt-set ps_opt_gating_quant_longctx_v1 --baseline /tmp/baseline_config.json --diff /tmp/config_diff.json --output /tmp/out"
```

Omar El-Sayed: also note: this failure correlates w/ KV cache toggle from the diff. if you want to isolate, there’s a smaller repro prompt set: `ps_opt_gating_longctx_kv_edge_003` (same long-doc cases, fewer total prompts).

Olivia Grant: good call. for faster iteration:
```bash
./bin/eval-harness gating run \
  --suite optimize_gating_smoke_v1 \
  --prompt-set ps_opt_gating_longctx_kv_edge_003 \
  --baseline /tmp/baseline_config.json \
  --diff /tmp/config_diff.json \
  --output /tmp/smoke_repro \
  --seed 1337
```

Sana Farid: if you’re comparing to the Console outcome: make sure you’re using the same aggregation settings. gating uses paired deltas and requires `min_n=200` for that suite.

Sana Farid: if you run smoke you’ll see the direction, but the pass/fail might flip bc of sample size.

Leila Farouk: got it. what metric actually fails here?

Olivia Grant: in `results.json` it’s `task_success_rate` on the longctx set. delta was ~ -1.8% vs baseline, threshold is -1.0% for quant profile changes.

Grace Kim: and it spikes specifically on prompts tagged `long_context: true` + `format: json`. (we suspect quant profile is impacting structured output consistency under long ctx)

Leila Farouk: awesome, ty. i’ll run on H100 w/ the baseline+diff from artifacts and start w/ `ps_opt_gating_longctx_kv_edge_003`.

Olivia Grant: ping me if it still won’t repro — we can also replay exactly via the Optimize trigger payload:
```bash
curl -X POST "$EVAL_HARNESS_URL/api/v1/gating/trigger" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @/tmp/optimize_trigger_payload_gtr_9f2c1d6a.json
```

Leila Farouk: :thumbsup: (reactions: Connor O'Brien added :thumbsup:)
